source: Official UCR 2018 DataSummary.csv linked by the UCR archive page
population: All 128 UCR 2018 univariate classification archive constituents, matched by exact name to aeon UCR2019 inventory and repo audit list
task_and_architecture: Each is labeled univariate time-series classification. Finite lengths are fixed-width numeric vectors and structurally compatible with the repository fixed-width MLP after flattening. Entries marked Vary require an explicit padding/truncation representation. Whole-batch raw input and first-layer estimates are listed for finite lengths only.
difficulty_evidence: Official spreadsheet provides the default/majority-class error rate and test error rates for Euclidean and two DTW 1-NN baselines. These are individually recorded as difficulty context, not evidence of non-saturation of the repo MLP. No MLP pilot was run because the archive route fails the stated password-free/open-license gates.
rights_and_access: The official archive page states the briefing document provides a password required to unlock the archive. The archive CSV/briefing metadata does not provide an explicit license per constituent or blanket reuse license. Individual donor/editor is recorded, but upstream rights were not resolved.
decision: Cross out all 128 for this specific UCR archive route. Do not generalize the rejection to separately hosted official versions without checking their exact artifact and license.
